mapper.select: SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM( SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{secId} AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (IS_CANCEL='N' or IS_CANCEL IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{secId} )

SELECT Min(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM( SELECT Min(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{secId} AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (IS_CANCEL='N' or IS_CANCEL IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT Min(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{secId} )

select distinct t2.ITEM_VALUE ITEM_CODE from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN t1 inner join sys_datadict_list t2 on t2.DICT_CODE = 'EXEC_MODE' and t1.EXERCISE_TYPE = t2.ITEM_CODE where t1.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE2_F01} and t1.EXERCISE_TYPE in (#{EXEC_MODE_01}, #{EXEC_MODE_02})
AND t1.FINPROD_ID = #{secId}

select T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.ENTRUST_STATUS entrustStatus, T8.REAL_NAME invManagerId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T3.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, T4.type_11 secType1, T1.PS as ps, NVL(T1.ENTRUST_NUM,0) / 100 shareNum, T1.PRICE_MODEL priceModel, T1.PRICE unitPrice, T7.FULL_PRICE allPrice, T7.MATURE_YIELD*100 matureYield, T7.EXER_YIELD*100 exerYield, T7.SETTLE_SPREED as settleSpreed, T1.vdate etrDate, T1.REMARK as remark ,T1.INV_AIM as businessModel from ETR_ENTRUST T1 INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID, SUM( FINISH_AMT) as FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) T5 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T5.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T7 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T7.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER T8 ON T1.INV_MANAGER_ID = T8.USER_NAME LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID where 1=1
AND T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}

if.test: search != null and search != '' and search !='有效'

mapper.select: select T1.ccy,T1.Calendar_Id as calendarId,T1.vdate vdate,T1.mdate mdate from fin_product T1 where T1.finprod_id = #{entrustId}
SELECT DISTINCT A.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, A.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName from PTL_PORTFOLIO A where A.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{entrustId} and rownum=1
